scope: Primary official documentation review only; no account creation, credentials, API playback authentication, product edits, backend, proxy, or DRM workaround.

amazonMusic.developerAccess: Closed beta. Security Profile must be enabled by Amazon Music; access is limited to approved developers and production integration must be validated.
amazonMusic.login: Login with Amazon OAuth 2.0. Catalog and playback scopes are separate; generic LWA registration does not grant Music access.
amazonMusic.staticLoginFlow: LWA browser-based authorization code grant with PKCE; client_secret is omitted and token exchange occurs in browser. No refresh token; reauthentication required after access token expiry.
amazonMusic.fullPlaybackModel: Authorized queue/playback API returns expiring playbackInformation including protocol, format, URL, licenseURL/licenseHeaders and requires reporting playback events. This is not a public clear MP3 catalog.
amazonMusic.consumerAccount: Customer authentication and applicable account entitlement are required. Exact plan/market permissions must be checked for the approved integration; no general assumption that every account can play every track on demand.
amazonMusic.pwaFeasibility: Conditional on Amazon approval and supported licensed playback/browser stack; do not present backend as universally required for OAuth, or present current static PWA integration as verified.

sources.supports: Closed beta, approval/enabled Security Profile, customer consent, Music scopes.
Option 2 browser-based PKCE without client_secret; no refresh token.
Playback scope, queue/event lifecycle, streaming and DRM playbackInformation.
Program approval and no further onboarding on deprecated Device API.

jamendo.productionCredential: Must obtain own registered client_id; no borrowed keys or official test ID for production.
jamendo.catalogLimit: Alternative independent catalog; no claim to substitute the mainstream catalogs requested.

bandcamp.scope: Authenticated fan collection already purchased, not global free catalog.

audiomack.documentedAuth: OAuth 1.0a. Official non-authenticated read example still signs using consumer key and consumer secret.
audiomack.streamingUrls: Official play endpoint returns expiring MP3 source; not tested without own application credentials.
audiomack.claimLimit: Documented API exists, but no safe pure-static secretless integration has been validated.
